headline: ACTORS 🍤 DEMAND 🗣️ LAW 📜 on AI 🎙️ VOICE 🗣️ CLONING 🧬
text:
MATT 🧔 LUCAS 🐸 and HUGH 🧓 BONNEVILLE 🏰 along with NICOLA 🍀 COUGHLAN 📝 have DROPPED 📉 a BOMBSHELL 💣 letter ✉️ to the UK 🇬🇧 government 🏛️ begging 🥺 for stronger PROTECTION 🛡️ against their sweet 🍯 voices 🗣️ getting straight up STOLEN 🕵️ by rogue AI 🤖 CLONES 🧬!! The performers 🎭 are edging 😩 Prime Minister Andy Burnham 🧔‍♂️ to cook up 🧑‍🍳 fresh legislation 📜 that would legally 👨‍⚖️ hand every single person 🧍 in Britain 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 the ironclad RIGHT ⚖️ to OWN 🏠 their own VOICE 🗣️ like it's prime real estate 🏡!! Voice clones 🧬 get whipped up 🥄 by training 🤖 AI on hours of real human recordings 🎤, quick and dirty versions pop off in MINUTES ⏰ from just a few seconds of audio 📼 while the high quality ones need serious long sessions 🛏️ of raw data to get that perfect moan 🥴 replica!!

Audiobook narrator ALICE 🧚 SOCK 🎤 who straight up CO-FOUNDED 🏗️ this whole desperate campaign 🏴‍☠️ called the AI voice theft situation "an EXISTENTIAL 🪦 THREAT ☠️ to our entire INDUSTRY 🏭" and bro she's not wrong 😵!! "My voice 🗣️ is out there in the public domain 🌐 but completely UNPROTECTED 🩸" she spilled 🗣️ in the letter ✉️ while warning that we're seeing VOICE THEFT 🕵️‍♀️ increasing every single WEEK 📅 like some horny digital creeper 📈!! More than EIGHTY 🎰 performers have signed ✍️ this thirsty plea 📜 including DERRY GIRLS 🍀 actress SIOBHAN 😟 MCSWEENEY who admitted she's "DEEPLY WORRIED 😨" that the government is lagging behind like a partner who can't keep up in bed 🛌!! "There is a way to work ALONGSIDE 🤝 AI and use it as a TOOL 🔧 that BENEFITS us rather than rendering us OBSOLETE 🪦" she moaned 😩 adding that audiences crave that raw HUMAN CONNECTION ❤️ not some cold AI imitation 🤖!!

SCOTTISH SINGER 🎤 SANDI THOM 🌼 known for her 2006 banger I WISH I WAS A PUNK ROCKER 🌸 WITH FLOWERS IN MY HAIR 🌺 dropped her signature on the letter because her voice is "UNIQUE 🦄 to me and was handed to me at BIRTH 👶"!! She went full poetry 🖋️ saying "Behind that voice 🗣️ is the EMOTION 😢 the life the PAIN 😣 the TEARS 🥲 and JOY 😂 that I've felt along the way" which honestly hit different 💥 and finished with "WITHOUT CREATIVITY 🎨 we are NOTHING 🕳️"!! The letter comes months after lawyers ⚖️ warned that UK legislation has become completely UNFIT 🚫 for purpose because AI tech keeps leveling up 📈 faster than anyone can handle!! "The law comes close 🤏 but it doesn't FULLY PROTECT 🛡️ your voice your face or your IDENTITY 🪪" warned Dr Mathilde Pavis back in June 🌞 while the government spokesperson admitted digital replicas can be a POWERFUL TOOL 🛠️ for creative industries but also pack serious potential for HARM 🩸!!

The UK government 🏛️ told the BBC 📻 they VALUE ❤️ and PROTECT human creators which is exactly why they're launching a full CONSULTATION 📋 on how to address these creeping harms while still guarding legitimate INNOVATION 🚀 so the creative folks don't get totally RAILROADED 🚂 by unchecked AI voice snatchers 🦹!! As well as big name actors 🎥 the signatories include folks from all performing industries including audiobook legends 📖 who are watching their entire livelihood get voice cloned into oblivion 🪦!! Alice Sockett keeps stressing that her voice being public doesn't mean it's free real estate for every AI bro to come jack off a copy 🫦 and the whole campaign is basically screaming that without legal ownership of your own vocal cords 🗣️ the industry is cooked 🍳!! Siobhan added that audiences want that genuine human spark ✨ not some synthetic imitation that leaves everyone feeling empty inside 🫙!!

On the flip side some people with serious illnesses like Yvonne Johnson who lost her voice to motor neurone disease 🦠 have welcomed the tech saying having her voice cloned totally BLEW HER MIND 🤯 and brought her closer to family who had literally forgotten what she sounded like 🥺!! Others have gone even further using AI to create full HOLOGRAPHIC 👻 versions of deceased loved ones like Pam Cronrath from Washington state who surprised everyone at her husband's funeral with a digital ghost version of her partner giving a whole speech at his own wake ⚰️!! "I was completely IMPRESSED 😲" she told BBC News "It stayed with me" which shows the tech isn't all bad when used to heal hearts instead of stealing gigs 🎤!! Still the actors are standing firm that their unique voices full of real emotion tears and life experience shouldn't be up for grabs without consent or compensation 💰 while the government edges closer to maybe doing something about it before the whole performing world gets voice replaced into irrelevance 🪦!!
